To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the dynamic performance of a mechanical structure, such as a BPM support, can be improved by using FE calculations and vibration measurements to guide the design.
the dynamic performance of a beam position monitor support is greatly improved by changing the soft connections between its base and the ground from ground bolts to full grout.
the mechanical stability of a BPM support can be improved by a full-grouted connection to the ground instead of a bolted connection.
